multiBet.title: Sending a prediction to all your tournaments
multiBet.intro1: You can send a specific prediction to all the tournaments you take part in
multiBet.intro2: using the toggle at the top left that appears while editing a prediction:
multiBet.switchOn: When the toggle is <1><2>on</2></1>, the header background turns purple and clicking "Send" sends the prediction <3><4>to all tournaments</4></3>
multiBet.switchOff: When the toggle is <1><2>off</2></1>, the header background uses the current tournament's color and clicking "Send" sends the prediction only <3><4>to the current tournament</4></3>
multiBet.defaultStateLabel: You can set a default for the toggle's initial state:

nihus.howToIntro: During live games, you can click the tomato next to whoever you want to Nihus, and a Nihus sending form will open:

nihus.toggleOffInfo: If you're tired of seeing so many tomatoes, you can turn off the Nihusim toggle in the user menu and the tomatoes will disappear:

waitForMvp.title: Wait, it's not over yet...
waitForMvp.body1: The tournament MVP hasn't been announced yet, so the score shown is not the final score.
waitForMvp.body2: After the tournament MVP is announced, the score will update and the final leaderboard will be shown.
